abstract: PURPOSE: To compare first-line high-dose chemotherapy (HD-CT) with autologous blood stem-cell transplantation to standard-dose chemotherapy (SD-CT) in male patients with advanced germ cell tumors (GCTs), a matched-pair analysis was performed within a homogenous group of patients classified as having either Indiana advanced disease or a poor prognosis according to International Germ Cell Cancer Consensus Group (IGCCCG) criteria. PATIENTS AND METHODS: A multivariate analysis was performed that included 147 consecutive patients who had received sequential high-dose cisplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide (VIP) therapy (HD-CT) in a German multicenter trial between 1993 and 1997 and 309 patients who had been treated with standard-dose cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (PEB) or VIP chemotherapy (SD-CT) within two randomized trials at Indiana University between 1984 and 1992. RESULTS: Multivariate analysis demonstrated HD-CT to be significantly superior to SD-CT when adjustments were made for prognostic factors (P =.021). Primary tumor site (mediastinal v retroperitoneal/gonadal, P =.035) and presence of visceral metastases (P =.0004) were shown to be significant prognostic factors for overall survival. On the basis of these factors, as well as on tumor marker levels (good, intermediate, or poor, according to IGCCCG criteria), 146 of 147 HD-CT patients were fully matched to an SD-CT patient. Median follow-up was 21 months (range, 0 to 70 months) for the HD-CT patients and 22 months (range, 0 to 90 months) for the SD-CT patients. Two-year progression-free survival (75% v 59%) and overall survival (82% v 71%) were significantly prolonged in HD-CT patients (P =.0056 and P =.0184, respectively). CONCLUSION: The results indicate that first-line HD-CT in patients with poor-prognosis GCT may result in a significant improvement of progression-free and overall survival as compared with SD-CT. Salvage HD-CT seems not to compensate this survival advantage.
abstract_ja: 目的：進行期の男性胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)患者において、初回大量化学療法(HD-CT)と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を併用した方法と、標準量化学療法(SD-CT)を比較するため、マッチドペア解析を実施した。対象と方法：IGCCCG基準によりIndiana進行病変または予後不良に分類された男性患者を対象とした。多変量解析には、1993年から1997年にドイツの多施設共同試験で順次大量シスプラチン・エトポシド・イホスファミド(VIP)療法を受けた147例(HD-CT)と、1984年から1992年にIndiana大学の2つのランダム化試験で標準量のPEBまたはVIP療法(SD-CT)を受けた309例を含めた。結果：予後因子で調整した多変量解析では、HD-CTがSD-CTより有意に優れていた(P=.021)。原発部位(縦隔対後腹膜/性腺、P=.035)と内臓転移の有無(P=.0004)は全生存期間の有意な予後因子であった。これらの因子およびIGCCCG基準による腫瘍マーカーレベル(良好、中等度、不良)に基づき、HD-CT群147例中146例をSD-CT群の1例とマッチさせた。中央値の追跡期間はHD-CT群21か月(0〜70か月)、SD-CT群22か月(0〜90か月)であった。2年無増悪生存率(75%対59%)および全生存率(82%対71%)はHD-CT群で有意に延長していた(P=.0056、P=.0184)。結論：予後不良GCT患者に対する初回HD-CTは、SD-CTと比較して無増悪生存期間および全生存期間の有意な改善をもたらす可能性がある。救援大量化学療法は、この生存上の利益を補うものではないと思われる。
